### 核心 Framing (D056)
Structural pruning criterion determines post-RLVR recovery capacity. Under controlled GRPO (identical v5 config), 4 methods reveal a **recovery capacity gradient**:
**CKA-only >> Random >> Standard > RASP**

Three failure modes:
1. CKA-only: Active learning (peak reward 0.354, self-recovery from perturbation)
2. Random: Stagnation (reward oscillates 0.14-0.19, never learns)
3. Standard: Borderline collapse (reward < 0.08, grad_norm → 0.017)
4. RASP: Full collapse (reward ~0.01, frac_zero_std 0.85)

## Core Framing (D056 - Recovery Capacity Gradient)

4 pruning methods compared under identical GRPO v5 config reveal a recovery capacity gradient:
**CKA-only >> Random >> Standard > RASP**

Three failure modes:
1. CKA-only: Active learning (peak reward 0.354 at step 50, self-recovery from step 90 dip to 0.344 at step 100)
2. Random: Stagnation (reward oscillates 0.14-0.19, never lifts off)
3. Standard: Borderline collapse (reward < 0.08, grad_norm→0.017)
4. RASP: Full collapse (reward ~0.01, frac_zero_std 0.85)

## Section Structure (word budget ~2500)

§4.1 Setup: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, 28 layers, GQA 28/4, MLP 18944. GSM8K eval (N=1319). 20% sparsity, 4 methods, identical v5 GRPO config (lr=1e-6, maxlen=1024, beta=0.01, temp=0.4, DAPO). 2x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000.

§4.2 Recovery Capacity Gradient (Main finding): Table 1 + Figure 2 + Figure 3.
GRPO dynamics data:
- CKA-only: peak 0.3544(s50), final 0.3444(s100), best frac_zero_std 0.125(s70), self-recovery from 0.242(s90)→0.344(s100)
- Random: peak 0.190(s70), flat 0.14-0.19, frac_zero_std ~0.30-0.35
- Standard: peak 0.081(s40), final 0.054, frac_zero_std ~0.50-0.63, grad_norm→0.017
- RASP: peak 0.061(s20), final 0.010, frac_zero_std→0.850

Unpruned: peak 0.669(s80), final 0.661, stable all 100 steps

§4.3 Reward-Accuracy Decoupling: Table 2.
SFT accuracy (N=1319): Unpruned 81.27%, CKA-only 63.91%, RASP 61.49%, Standard 59.29%
GRPO accuracy (N=1319): Unpruned 81.27% (Δ=0.00pp), Standard 58.91% (Δ=-0.38pp), RASP 60.65% (Δ=-0.84pp)
CKA-only GRPO accuracy: not yet available, mark as TBD

§4.4 SFT Gradient: CKA-only 63.91% > RASP 61.49% > Standard 59.29% (N=1319). CKA-only vs Standard Δ=4.62pp, p≈0.015.

§4.5 Sparsity Cliff: Table 4. At 30%, all collapse:
Standard: 4% acc, 5.5% EOS rate. RASP: 0% acc, 3% EOS rate. CKA-only: 0% acc.

§4.6 Inference Speedup: Table 5.
Dense: 6.682s, 16.22GB. RASP: 4.156s (37.8%), 11.60GB (28.5%). Standard: 6.167s (7.7%), 11.61GB (28.4%).

§4.7 Ablation: Table 3. Alpha sweep (N=100, 20%):
α=0.0: 27%. α=0.25: 23%. α=0.5: 22%. α=1.0: 31%. α=2.0: 36%.

§4.8 Discussion: gradient importance as harmful factor for RL trainability. Connection to Self-Healing claims.
